document.abstract: (1.1) This standard specifies the lateral location, dimensions, and the reproducing speed of variable-area and variable-density photographic audio records on 16-mm motion-picture prints. (1.2) This standard also specifies the longitudinal picture-audio displacement. (1.3) The standard further specifies the width scanned in the audio reproducer.
